stages.label: Site and composition
stages.description: Raise the rock pinnacle above the cloud line, reserve the atrium void and pave the plaza.

stages.label: Major masses
stages.description: Rasterise the atrium tower, the stepped reading rings, the satellite towers and platforms as storeyed shells.

stages.label: Rooms and circulation
stages.description: Insert stair cores, cut doors between rooms and onto terraces, lay sky bridges and outdoor stairs; record the room graph.

stages.label: Rule-driven growth
stages.description: Rewrite rules decide window bays, open the atrium galleries and grow gardens across the terraces.

stages.label: Constraint checks
stages.description: Traverse the circulation graph from the entrance and test voids, headroom, occupancy and support.

stages.label: Architectural detailing
stages.description: Bookshelves, trees, shrubs and lanterns are placed by local rules.

stages.label: Composition refinement
stages.description: Merge some window bays into ribbons and keep doorways clear, then re-check circulation.
